# `@filemark/chart` — component plan

First rich component after the datagrid. Single biggest visual upgrade
for quantitative planning docs — metrics dashboards, trend reports,
comparative analyses, progress charts.

- **Status:** plan (nothing built)
- **Opened:** 2026-04-23
- **Depends on:** `@filemark/datagrid`'s CSV parse + column-type
  inference (reused, not duplicated).
- **Consumed by:** `@filemark/mdx` via a new `Chart` tag + fenced
  `chart` / `bar` / `line` / `pie` / `scatter` / `area` blocks.

---

## 1. Goal

Author writes markdown with some CSV data, gets an interactive chart
with zero config:

````md
```chart type=line x=month y=revenue title="Monthly revenue"
month,revenue
Jan,12400
Feb,15800
Mar,18200
```
````

Or, for data that lives in a sibling file:

```md
<Chart type="bar" src="./metrics.csv" x="region" y="units,revenue" stacked />
```

Every feature is opt-in via info-string flags, same grammar as the
datagrid — so the learning curve is zero for anyone who's used
datagrids already.

---

## 2. Package decision

**New package: `packages/chart/` → `@filemark/chart`.**

Rationale:
- Keeps `@filemark/datagrid` focused on tabular-with-cells.
- Lets the chart pkg evolve / swap renderer independently.
- Consumer graph stays clean: `chart` re-imports `parseCSV` +
  `inferTypes` + `ColumnTypeSpec` + `DataGridOptions.typeSpecs` from
  datagrid via `workspace:*`. No duplication.

Alternative considered: fold chart into `@filemark/datagrid` under a
`Chart` export. Rejected — couples chart library's bundle size
(TanStack Table already ~60 KB, plus a chart lib would push consumers
past 150 KB just to show a bar chart).

---

## 3. Rendering library — **pick one**

| Option | Bundle (gz) | DX | Flexibility | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`recharts`** | ~50 KB | Excellent — composable React components, plays well with Tailwind + shadcn tokens via `stroke={'currentColor'}` | Covers every v1 type + most v2 | **Recommended default.** |
| `chart.js` + `react-chartjs-2` | ~70 KB | Good — imperative + React wrapper | Covers everything, plugin ecosystem | Bigger + wrapper overhead |
| `@tremor/react` | ~30 KB on top of recharts | Very high-level | Only charts Tremor ships | Locks us in; styling mismatch |
| `visx` | Tree-shake to ~25–40 KB | Primitive — build your own chart | Infinite | Too low-level for Tier 1 |
| Handrolled SVG | 0 KB | We own every pixel | Just bar + line in v1, pie/scatter are real work | Punts v2+ pain to the library |

**My recommendation: `recharts`.** Single dep, React-composable, maps
cleanly to shadcn tokens (`stroke`, `fill` = `currentColor` +
`text-primary` / `text-chart-N` utilities), handles every v1 type
without custom work. Lazy-loaded (dynamic `import("recharts")`) so
chart-free docs don't pay the ~50 KB cost.

Confirm this before I write code — swapping libraries later = rewriting
the renderer layer.

---

## 4. Authoring surface — two entry points

Mirrors the datagrid's two entry points exactly:

### 4.1 Fenced block (preferred for inline data)

````md
```chart type=line x=month y=revenue title="Revenue"
month,revenue
Jan,12400
Feb,15800
```
````

Supported lang aliases — pick one, rest route the same way:
`chart`, `bar`, `line`, `pie`, `scatter`, `area`.

The lang also sets the default `type` flag: ` ```bar ` without
`type=` renders a bar chart. Shorter for one-off charts.

### 4.2 `<Chart>` tag (preferred for external data + long props)

```md
<Chart
  type="bar"
  src="./sales.csv"
  x="region"
  y="units,revenue"
  stacked
  title="Q2 sales" />
```

Same attribute conventions as `<Datagrid>` — `src` absolute or
relative, `meta` escape-hatch for colon-bearing flags if any appear
later.

Both paths share a single renderer (`<ChartView>` component); the fence
parses info-string → `ChartOptions`, the tag parses HTML attrs →
`ChartOptions`, both feed the renderer.

---

## 5. Info-string grammar

Extends the datagrid's parser (same tokenizer). Chart-specific flags:

| Flag | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `type=<bar\|line\|pie\|scatter\|area>` | `bar` | Or via lang tag (` ```line ` → line). |
| `x=<col>` | first column | Category axis (bar/line/area) or x numeric (scatter). |
| `y=<col>[,<col>,…]` | second column | One or more series. Multi-value = multi-series chart. |
| `by=<col>` | — | Group-by for multi-series (alternative to listing cols in `y`). |
| `stacked` | off | Stack bars / areas. |
| `horizontal` | off | Flip bar chart to horizontal. |
| `smooth` | off | Line type: monotone spline instead of straight. |
| `show-dots` | on for line, off for area | Per-point markers. |
| `show-grid` | on | Grid lines. |
| `show-legend` | on when > 1 series | Legend under chart. |
| `show-x-axis` / `show-y-axis` | on | Toggle axes. |
| `x-label=<text>` / `y-label=<text>` | inferred from col label | Axis titles. |
| `height=<px>` | 260 | Chart height. |
| `title=<text>` | — | Above-chart title. |
| `src=<path>` | — | Same rules as datagrid: absolute URL direct fetch, relative via `AssetResolver`. |
| `delimiter=<char>` | `,` | Parsing delimiter. |
| `header=<bool>` | on | Header row. |
| `colors=<tone1,tone2,…>` | palette | Semantic tones (`primary,success,warn,danger,info,secondary`) or hex. One per series. |
| `format:<col>=<fmt>` | auto | Per-column value format (`currency(USD)`, `percentage`, `filesize`, `number(#,##0.0)`). Drives tick labels + tooltip formatting. |
| `sort=<col>[:asc\|desc]` | file order | Sort data before plotting. |
| `limit=<n>` | — | Show only top-n (after sort); useful for long-tail data. |
| `reference-line=<value>` | — | Horizontal reference line (e.g. a target / budget). |

Unknown flag → console warn, chart still renders. Same skeleton-honesty
rule as datagrid.

Pie-chart-specific:
| Flag | Notes |
|---|---|
| `value=<col>` | alias for `y` on pie charts |
| `name=<col>` | alias for `x` on pie charts |
| `donut` | render donut (inner radius) |
| `show-total` | center label with the sum |

---

## 6. Data input — pipeline

```
fence body  ─┐
src=./csv   ─┼─▶  parseCSV (from @filemark/datagrid)
src=https:  ─┘         → { columns: Column[], rows: Row[] }
                             │
                             ▼
                 transformForChart(columns, rows, options)
                             │
                             ▼
                 recharts <LineChart | BarChart | PieChart | …>
```

`transformForChart` projects `rows` to the shape recharts wants — e.g.
for line chart: `[{x: "Jan", revenue: 12400}, …]`. Handles:

- Pivot when `by=<col>` is set (one row per x, columns become series).
- Stacked totals.
- Numeric coercion on y cols (reuses datagrid's coerce).
- Date coercion on x cols when x col type is `date`.

No computation beyond reshape — recharts handles the layout + ticks.

---

## 7. File plan

```
packages/chart/
├── package.json                         @filemark/chart, deps: @filemark/core, @filemark/datagrid, recharts
├── tsconfig.json
├── tsup.config.ts                       external recharts (lazy), react(-dom), @filemark/*
└── src/
    ├── index.ts                         exports Chart, ChartFromText, parseChartInfoString
    ├── types.ts                         ChartType, ChartOptions, ChartSeriesConfig
    ├── parseChartInfoString.ts          extends datagrid's info-string tokenizer
    ├── transformForChart.ts             (columns, rows, options) → recharts data shape
    ├── Chart.tsx                        main renderer — switch on type → BarChart / LineChart / …
    ├── ChartFromText.tsx                wraps Chart, parses CSV first (parallels DataGridFromText)
    ├── ChartBlock.tsx                   handles src= + fetch (parallels DataBlock)
    ├── palette.ts                       semantic-tone → stroke/fill class map
    ├── format.ts                        per-column value formatter (currency / percentage / etc)
    └── tooltip.tsx                      custom tooltip w/ shadcn styling

packages/mdx-viewer/src/
├── MDXViewer.tsx                        new lang-branch for chart / bar / line / pie / scatter / area
│                                        + new components.chart tag handler
└── ChartBlock.tsx                       thin wrapper — delegates to @filemark/chart's ChartBlock

apps/chrome-ext/… + apps/playground/…
└── tailwind `@source` already globs packages/*/src — no host changes needed.

examples/
├── chart-full.md                        one section per chart type + per flag combo
└── assets/metrics.csv                   sample data for src= demos

docsi/
├── CHART.md                             technical reference — written alongside the code
└── PLANNING_COMPONENTS.md               mark chart as shipped; move work-items to TASKS.md when done
```

---

## 8. Integration with `@filemark/mdx`

One new branch in `MDXViewer.components.code`, mirror of the csv/tsv/datagrid one:

```ts
const CHART_LANGS = ["chart", "bar", "line", "pie", "scatter", "area"];
if (CHART_LANGS.includes(lang)) {
  return (
    <ChartBlock
      source={raw}
      options={parseChartInfoString(meta, { defaultType: lang as ChartType })}
      assets={assets}
      storage={storage}
      storageKey={`${file.id}:chart:${hashString(raw + (meta ?? ""))}`}
    />
  );
}
```

Plus `components.chart: (p) => <ChartBlock options={attrsToChartOptions(p)} … />` for the `<Chart>` tag, matching the `<Datagrid>` pattern.

---

## 9. Interop with `@filemark/datagrid`

Both components will frequently point at the same CSV — e.g. a single
`sales.csv` showing as a datagrid *and* a chart. That's wasteful if
each re-parses via Papaparse.

**Short-term (v1):** both packages call `parseCSV` themselves; no
caching. Papaparse is fast enough that parsing the same ~100 KB file
twice costs a couple ms. Don't over-engineer.

**Mid-term (v2):** lift shared parse to `@filemark/core` or a new
`@filemark/csv` pkg + memoize by (source-text, delimiter). Matters if
someone references the same file from > 3 components.

**Don't build the cache until it's needed.**

---

## 10. Theming

Chart colors use a semantic palette:

```ts
// palette.ts
export const CHART_TONES = {
  primary:   "var(--color-primary)",
  success:   "oklch(0.72 0.17 160)",
  warn:      "oklch(0.75 0.17 80)",
  danger:    "oklch(0.62 0.22 25)",
  info:      "oklch(0.7 0.16 260)",
  secondary: "var(--color-secondary)",
  muted:     "var(--color-muted-foreground)",
} as const;

export const DEFAULT_SEQUENCE = [
  "primary", "success", "warn", "info", "danger", "secondary",
] as const;
```

Author override via `colors=primary,danger,muted`. Hex accepted
(`colors=#0ea5e9,#f43f5e`). Recharts accepts `stroke`/`fill` as CSS
vars directly, so theme-switching is automatic.

---

## 11. Accessibility

- Every chart gets an `aria-label` from `title` or a deterministic
  summary (`"line chart of revenue over month, 3 series"`).
- Tooltip content is announced via `role="tooltip"`.
- Data table fallback: if `show-table` flag is set (or the chart
  fails to render), the same data renders as a small
  `@filemark/datagrid` below the chart. Screen readers + no-JS get
  the numbers.
- Keyboard: tab into the chart → arrow keys cycle through points,
  enter / space copies the point's value.

---

## 12. Scope cuts (v1 → v2)

### v1 (first ship, ~1–2 days)

- Types: `bar`, `line`, `pie` only (covers 80% of planning-doc charts).
- Single or multi-series (via `y=a,b,c` or `by=<col>`).
- `stacked`, `horizontal`, `smooth`, grid / legend / axis toggles.
- `title`, `x-label`, `y-label`.
- Inline data + `src=` external (relative + absolute URL).
- Semantic palette + hex overrides.
- Per-column format (`currency`, `percentage`, `filesize`,
  `number(#,##0)`) for axes + tooltips.
- Reference line.
- `<Chart>` tag parallel to `<Datagrid>`.
- Table-fallback toggle (`show-table`).

### v2 (later, based on actual pain)

- `scatter`, `area`, `funnel`, `radar`, `treemap`.
- Dual y-axis (different scales for two series).
- Brush / zoom (time-series drill-in).
- Shared tooltip across multiple charts in the same doc (for
  dashboards).
- `annotations=<col>` — show text labels at specific points.
- CSV-cache interop with datagrid (§9).
- Small-multiples (facet by column).

---

## 13. Work-item breakdown (when it's time to build)

1. **Package scaffold** — `packages/chart/` w/ package.json, tsconfig,
   tsup config (recharts + react + @filemark/core + @filemark/datagrid
   marked external). ~30 min.
2. **`types.ts`** — `ChartType`, `ChartOptions`, `ChartSeriesConfig`.
3. **`parseChartInfoString.ts`** — extends datagrid's tokenizer; adds
   chart-specific flags. Unit-test the grammar.
4. **`transformForChart.ts`** — `(columns, rows, options) → {data, series}`.
   Handles by-pivot, stacking, numeric coercion. Unit-test with a few
   CSVs.
5. **`palette.ts` + `format.ts`** — trivial modules; palette maps
   tones → CSS vars, format delegates to Intl.NumberFormat.
6. **`Chart.tsx`** — switch on `options.type` → recharts primitives.
   Start with `bar` + `line` + `pie`. Add `show-*` toggles. Write the
   custom tooltip.
7. **`ChartFromText.tsx`** — thin parser wrapper.
8. **`ChartBlock.tsx`** — `src=` fetch handling, copy-paste of
   DataBlock's pattern.
9. **MDX integration** — new lang-branch in `MDXViewer.components.code`
   + `components.chart` tag handler.
10. **Showcase** — `examples/chart-full.md` with one section per
    chart type + flag combo; `examples/assets/metrics.csv` for src=
    demos.
11. **Playground integration** — bundle `examples/chart-full.md` into
    playground's gallery + ensure recharts lazy-loads properly.
12. **Tech ref doc** — `docsi/CHART.md` (written alongside code — not
    before, not after).
13. **Typecheck + build verification** across all packages, the
    chrome-ext, and the playground.
14. **Commit** (one focused commit per PR-sized chunk: scaffold,
    parser + transform, renderer, MDX wiring, examples).

Total estimate: **1.5–2 days** of focused work assuming recharts is
chosen and no rough edges emerge with the CSP (recharts runs fine
under MV3 — no eval — verified from prior audits, but should double
check before shipping).

---

## 14. Open questions before code

1. **Library confirm** — go with `recharts`, or pick another? (§3).
2. **v1 scope** — bar + line + pie enough, or do you want scatter /
   area in the first ship too? (§12).
3. **Tag vs fence default** — my spec supports both equally, but if
   you have a preference we can emphasize one in the tech docs +
   examples.
4. **CSS tokens for chart colors** — I proposed semantic tones +
   CSS vars. Confirm or pick a custom palette (would add
   `--chart-1` … `--chart-6` vars to the shadcn token set).
5. **Deploy stencils** — should the playground bundle a pre-made
   example CSV or reuse `sales.csv` from the datagrid demos? (Lower
   bundle size to reuse.)
6. **Table fallback** — default on or off for a11y? (Likely on; cost
   is negligible since we already have `@filemark/datagrid`.)

---

## 15. When picked for build

- Copy §12 v1 scope + §13 work-items into `TASKS.md` as milestone M8.
- Mark this doc as "in progress".
- On ship, mark as shipped in `ROADMAP.md §1` (pillar 1) and move the
  tech ref out of the code-alongside note in §13 into an actual
  `docsi/CHART.md` in the same PR.

---
